editorial.assessment: Paxton is a clearly UK-based charity-accounting option with current public prices, church-oriented accounting workflows and a desktop alternative to its online service. Its Standard and Advanced split makes the first procurement question practical: whether the church needs receipts-and-payments accounting or the additional sales, project and foreign-currency capability. A treasurer should test reports, migration, permissions, bank reconciliation and year-end work with the actual accounts before changing system.

Churches that need to compare receipts-and-payments and accruals workflows
